_comment: Refit (the build popup's id 25), work order 223. Geometry: screens/refit/refgeom.py; drawing and marks: refdraw.py, refwords.py, screen.py. Each mark is held by the smoke group and named in dev:doc/state/refit.md.

words._note: DEVIATION `button_words`: the ship list's title and its buttons carry their words in REFITPUP.LBX art (colrefit.cpp:325-338); HD draws them in code.
words.title: SELECT SHIP TO REFIT

marks.hd_state_first_row: HD STATE — the row the ship list starts at is a static of the original (_first_ship); HD counts the pages it sent itself and starts at the top.
marks.hd_state_picked_ship: HD STATE — the ship being refitted (_g_ship_n) is not on the wire; the design list names the ship HD picked.
marks.deviation_hud_parts: DEVIATION — REFITPUP.LBX 0 / 4 and its buttons are the HUD's popup, fields and buttons; the ship pictures, the refusal words and every game word are the original's.
marks.deviation_alone: DEVIATION — the original draws its window over the build popup; HD shows it alone over the background, the popup unchanged under it.
marks.omission_weapon_mods: OMISSION — a weapon's modification words are not printed in the paragraph; its count and name are.
